faces.name: Immediate Action
faces.oracleText:
Hidden agenda (Start the game with this conspiracy face down in the command zone and secretly choose a card name. You may turn this conspiracy face up any time and reveal that name.)
Creatures you control with the chosen name have haste.

faces.name: Immersturm
faces.oracleText:
Whenever a creature enters, that creature's controller may have it deal damage equal to its power to any target of their choice.
Whenever chaos ensues, exile target creature, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control.

faces.oracleText:

Host {1}{R} ({1}{R}: Host target creature at this Realm. A Realm can host any number of creatures. Host only as a sorcery.)

faces.oracleText:

Sacrifice another creature: This creature gains indestructible until end of turn. Tap it.

faces.name: Immersturm Raider
faces.oracleText: When this creature enters, you may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.

faces.oracleText:

{T}: Add {B}.

faces.name: Immerwolf
faces.oracleText:
Intimidate (This creature can't be blocked except by artifact creatures and/or creatures that share a color with it.)
Each other creature you control that's a Wolf or a Werewolf gets +1/+1.
